title: Carbon Composite Fixed-Wing UAV
description: A long-fuselage composite UAV concept with a conventional wing and tail, shaped for stable cruise and adaptable mission equipment. The arrangement keeps propulsion, avionics, and payload volume separated along a serviceable central body.
